title: Chapter 330 Gong Zheng Is Not Dead
content:
Chapter 330 Gong Zheng Is Not Dead

"Gong Zheng, hold him and jump down."

Wang Shuo yelled hysterically.

If they were hit by this thunder, everyone present would probably be in danger.

Gong Zheng has more than 30,000 HP, and also has the life feedback and damage rebound skills of "Vajra Sutra".

When the skill is activated, it can rebound 80% of the damage, maybe he can withstand this attack.

In order to be on the safe side, Wang Shuo also gave his most precious resurrection coin to Gong Zheng.

Gong Zheng also lived up to everyone's expectations and used a move of "Taishan Pressure".

This skill can be said to be a magical skill, which can directly get close to the body and also comes with stun.

Even if it is against the boss, it will take at least 0.5 seconds.

Coming in front of the Thunder Skeleton King, Gong Zheng directly locked the Skeleton King with his thick petrified arms to prevent him from breaking free after waking up.

Wang Shuo had to be thankful that this kind of forbidden spell-level big move took a long time to activate, otherwise, there would be no time to react.

Gong Zheng and Thunder Skeleton King fell directly from the city wall.

The 30-meter-high city wall was not fatal to the two of them, but the thunder ball between them.

It had the destructive power to destroy the world.

"Bang..."

...

A huge explosion sounded.

Like a thunderclap, it shocked countless undead and human soldiers in the entire East Gate.

The human soldiers even lost their hearing for a short time.

The East Gate was blown down in half.

The city gate passage below was buried directly.

If the city wall had not lost the protection of the formation, this attack would probably not have been so powerful.

But at this time, the durability of the city wall had been exhausted, and it was only a little stronger than an ordinary city wall.

The explosion directly blew away the undead warriors near the city gate and in the city wall.

The huge air wave hit the city wall of the city wall and rushed into the air.

Wang Shuo only saw countless ashes and some broken bones being blown up.

He was a little panicked.

What if the resurrection coin didn't work, then Gong Zheng would be dead?

After all, this explosion was much more powerful than the one when he blew up Toad Brunei.

"Gong Zheng."

Wang Shuo was a little panicked, shouted loudly, and immediately staggered to the edge of the broken city wall and looked down.

The scene below shocked Wang Shuo.

I saw a huge golden bell covering Gong Zheng.

Wang Shuo: ? ? ?

"Lord, I'm fine."

"I just broke through." He smiled and stood up, but a trace of blood still flowed from the corner of his mouth.

Wang Shuo looked at it and found that his blood volume was less than 200 points.

Wang Shuo showed a smile at the corner of his mouth, turned his head, and blew a breath from the slanted corner of his mouth.

And the tears in his eyes were rolling in his eye sockets.

He sniffed, coughed, and cleared his choked throat.

Between life and death, there is great terror, but also great opportunity!

Seeing that Gong Zheng also broke through the limit when he was on the verge of death, Wang Shuo couldn't help but have a new idea.

But this is too risky.

He shook his head and suddenly noticed that the skeletons outside the city rushed in again.

"Abu, catch up."

Wang Shuo immediately threw a rope to Ayub, and he descended rapidly.

The skeleton warriors in the distance rushed over quickly, and Gong Zheng was about to be surrounded.

After Wang Shuo landed on Gong Zheng's head, he immediately stretched out a hand.

Gong Zheng also stretched out a hand, and Ayub and Ye Tianba and others on the city wall quickly pulled the two up.

After returning to the city wall, Wang Shuo breathed a sigh of relief.
